AxisDir.description: An axis: X, Y or Z (any case), or a direction [x, y, z] that isn't zero.

LengthExpr.description: A length: a number in the design's length unit, or an expression such as "w / 2" or "30 mm".

Operation.description: How the feature combines with existing bodies: new, join, cut or intersect. The others are aliases. Matching ignores case, spaces, '_' and '-'.

Point3.description: A point in mm: [x, y, z] or {"x", "y", "z"}.

PointExpr3.description: A point: [x, y, z] or {"x", "y", "z"}, each a number in mm or a length expression.

StringList.description: A name, or a list of names.

input.description:
Add a cone or truncated cone: the base circle and, `height` along `axis`, the top circle (a
point when its radius is 1e-6 mm or less). Its radii, height and base are within 1e7 mm.

axis.description:
The direction `height` is measured along: from the base towards the top when `height` is
positive. Default: Z.

base.description: The centre of the base circle. Default: the origin.

body_names.description: Names for the new bodies, in order.

diameter.description: The base circle's diameter, instead of `radius`.

height.description:
The top's distance from the base along `axis`, more than 1e-6 mm either way; a negative
height goes the other way.

name.description: The feature's name in the timeline.

operation.description: How the cone combines with existing bodies. Default: new.

participants.description:
The bodies taking part, each an existing body or `*`; what that changes depends on the
feature.

radius.description:
The base circle's radius, above 1e-6 mm. Give it or `diameter`; when both are given,
`radius` is used.

targets.description:
The bodies a join, cut or intersect works on. Default: every body in the active
component (an intersect removes those the cone doesn't meet).
Ignored when `participants` lists bodies.

top_diameter.description: The top circle's diameter, instead of `top_radius`.

top_radius.description:
The top circle's radius, 0 or more; up to 1e-6 mm makes a full cone ending in a point.
When both are given, `top_radius` is used. Default: 0.

input.title: ConeParams

label: Cone

FeatureNotice.description: Something a feature's result tells the user without stopping them, with an action to take.

action.description: The command that changes the feature as the notice offers.

contact.description:
How the bodies split off touched the others: `along_edge`, `at_point` or `touching` (along
a line or at a point their boundaries don't hold).

NoticeAction.description: A command a notice offers to run.

changed_bodies.description: Bodies that were there before and now have other geometry.

ms.description: How long the feature took to evaluate, in milliseconds.

notice.description:
A join that split pieces into bodies of their own because they touch the others only along
an edge or at a point (its `touching: separate`): what to tell the user, and the edit that
makes them one body instead. Left out otherwise, also when the join kept pieces that touch
nothing in one body.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

warning.description:
A warning from the evaluation (a Boolean that needed a retry, a reference found again
elsewhere), or `null`.

params: radius | diameter, height: expr (the base circle, and the top's distance along the axis; a negative height goes the other way); top_radius? | top_diameter?: expr (the top circle; default 0: a full cone ending in an apex); base?: [x,y,z] (centre of the base circle: numbers in mm or length expressions; default: the origin); axis?: X|Y|Z|[x,y,z] (default Z); operation?, touching?, targets?: [body], name?, body_name?
